verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents scheduling the frequency of automatic payouts for connected accounts and offers instant payouts, so connected accounts can access balances right after a successful charge. This covers the core of per-seller scheduled and instant payouts, but the pack does not enumerate the specific intervals or confirm manual mode or the instant-payout destination rails. Missing for 10: explicit daily/weekly/monthly/manual interval options, documented per-seller configuration detail, instant payouts to debit cards or real-time rails and their regional availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller
